title: Kim Jong-un Commissions Second Choe Hyon-Class Destroyer 'Kang Kon' at Wonsan
detail: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, accompanied by his daughter Kim Ju-ae, attended the commissioning of the destroyer Kang Kon at Wonsan Port in Kangwon Province on September 6, 2026. The 5,000-tonne Choe Hyon-class warship — DPRK's second major surface combatant of the class after the Choe Hyon was commissioned at Nampho in June 2026 — can reportedly carry missiles capable of nuclear payloads. Kim said the vessel forms part of North Korea's nuclear response system, declaring 'the time has come for us to exercise our sovereignty at sea and under water.' The commissioning came one day before the US, South Korea and Japan began the five-day 'Freedom Edge' trilateral exercise near Jeju Island, which Seoul described as defensive.
